name: Soothing Familiar

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: While your familiar is within 120 feet of you, you and your allies within 5 feet of it treat 1s and 2s on healing dice as 3s.

benefits.name: Soothing Presence
benefits.summary: While your familiar is within 120 feet of you, you and your allies within 5 feet of it treat 1s and 2s on healing dice as 3s.
benefits.text: While your familiar is within 120 feet of you, whenever you or one of your allies within 5 feet of the familiar regains Hit Points from rolled dice (a spell, a potion, a feature or Hit Dice), each 1 or 2 rolled on those dice counts as a 3.
